guide.intent: Cards for the active projects the current user is on the team of: client, project no., project manager, construction start, permits issued of total, and what needs attention. A badge says whether the project is on track to have every permit issued by construction start.
decisions: Membership is the only role: a project team is a list of people, plus the project manager. "My projects" is every active project whose team includes the current user.

The badge is the readiness state of the whole project: At risk when the expected all-issued date is after construction start or a permit expires before it; All issued; Unconfirmed when a permit has no forecast; otherwise On track. The same rule drives the project page.
The cards re-read the project store, so an edited client, manager or construction start shows here without a rebuild.
gotchas: An empty state ("You're not on any active projects") points people to All projects, where they can open a project and add themselves to its team.
acceptance: Removing yourself from a project's team takes its card off My projects; adding yourself brings it back.
Moving a project's construction start earlier than its expected all-issued date turns its badge to At risk.

guide.intent: Every project in the tracker, whoever is on it, as an AG Grid, so anyone can reach a project they are not on, or a closed one, for its permits and files.
decisions: An esa-button-toggle (Active, Closed, All) filters by project status; Active is the default and Clear Filters returns to it. It is an external filter, so search and column filters apply on top.
Columns: project (links to the project page), project no., client, project manager, sites, permits issued of total, construction start, status.
The grid grows to its rows (autoHeight); a tracker holds dozens of projects, not thousands.
acceptance: Switching to Closed shows only closed projects; each project name opens its project page.
